notes.title: Devlog #15 - Car Wash and Deformation System
notes.content:
Hello Dear Fans,

We hope you are all doing fine in the new year. Our team is hard at work implementing more and more features into our game. 

Today we wanted to present you with two of them.

Firstly, Car Wash System, as you ride along Route 66 and many of the deserted areas along the road, your car will get dirtier and dirtier and none of us wants to have our beautiful Muscle Cars all dirty and in mud. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/9eda08b47282eba06d89ac6e9ee0d68ee2cff095.png[/img]

So that is why we have placed Car Washes along the road, so that as a player for a small fee you can get your car cleaned up. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/9f63ebceac4f2345f2f654c33e5f8694f3f3d2ad.png[/img]

When you enter the Carwash a cutscene plays out showing your beautiful vehicle starting to shine again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/01e82359999b78f096cd6f9f4a23e265ee2d12c0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/6243c45d7651e3602d892b24dc726e5aa26c2e04.png[/img]

And after we are done our car looks like a brand new vehicle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/85a8e85587eae63ec7a6ad6b818ba9997ebb6063.png[/img]

We also have a video for you showing how it works inside our game.

[previewyoutube=94UPAMKuiSU;full][/previewyoutube]

The other thing we have been working on is the Deformation System, which allows for destruction of our vehicle, when our car hits obstacles.
Car damage is divided into 3 levels of destruction. The damage occurs when the car hits at high speed (40mph+), where after each impact, the level of damage increases. After reaching destruction level 3, the car no longer destroys itself. To repair your car, you need to come to the workshop and repair the car for money.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/b03cd10f904bb2ae1ceabe1212113e2422d1c083.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/b4576e222cdee7d0ddf863d5f5c92232200de097.png[/img]

And here is a small peek into how it looks currently.
[previewyoutube=6eWDwN9oQ-o;full][/previewyoutube]

And that will be all for today, thank you once again for supporting us and remember to add our game to your wishlist, to be the first to know about all the news regarding Route 66 Simulator.

See you soon,
Grande Games

notes.title: Devlog #13 - Gas Station Renovation
notes.content:
Hello Dear Fans,

It's been a while since our last Devlog, but today we come to you with a new, exciting addition to our game. Over the past few weeks, our team has been hard at work improving various aspects of gameplay in our game and adding new features. Today, we would like to introduce one of them.

[b]Gas Station Renovation[/b] - as we call it, is a type of mission where you receive the task of cleaning up an old, abandoned gas station and restoring its long-lost glory.

First you will be tasked with cleaning old graffiti and dirt off the walls and floors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/ab5cfd9023a46d5539ad6ad79808c2b490a79991.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/a4c986be95d32adf114d5c045b02743d35f8bc98.gif[/img]

Then once you are finished, you will move on to getting rid of old furniture and what better way than a good old sledgehammer!! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/974fcf0bf1e043acda1399638393d4826fcf47a3.gif[/img]

Once you are done cleaning the station, you can move on to operating it.
You start by creating your own Logo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/b7f3bbecd99a4765ec5e49c27223be5be6b416cb.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/216d6d56f88296ef199e8ccadaf9daed1134b65e.gif[/img]

After that first customers will start arriving. 

At the beginning you will only be able to refuel their cars (but you will have to be careful not to tank more gas than you are asked for, otherwise you will not receive tips).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/73961f8ff7c11931c360dfbe23b0d3293686a042.gif[/img]

And also fix their wheels using automatic lift.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/e89f546399949733c17bab62f572869a2f88f16c.gif[/img]

After some time, you will be able to unlock new features for your gas station, using more and more difficult techniques to fix a car.


And that will be all for today Devlog, we hope you are excited about new features coming to our game. Be sure to let us know your opinion in the comments and remember to add our game to your wishlist.

See you soon,
Grande Games

notes.title: Devlog #12 - Bagdad Cafe and Photo Mode
notes.content:
Hello Dear Fans,

It has been some time since our last Devlog but our team was hard at work. We would like to sincerely thank all of you who have tested our Route 66 Simulator: The Free Ride Demo, we received over 100 surveys and we took a close look at all the suggestions and critiques you provided and started working on implementing them.

We were also hard at work on implementing new features and adding new historic locations to our game. Today we would like to showcase you Photo Mode, a system that allows you to take pictures of iconic Route 66 locations and storing their photos inside your album.

Here we have the location of “Bagdad Cafe”, recreated to match the look of one along Route 66.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/0b9148fe51542ff6504d1f63b4445188a4902115.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/0d9b819b6e4069fa81d94084ea1b0e0d82e926db.png[/img]

As you can see we have spent a lot of time making sure to recreate all the outdoor details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/e75c12bc9231abebba4754f8cb5397a881062875.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/7640e09accce165d6b861891b8df00ac726bac34.png[/img]

We have also spent a lot of time recreating furniture found inside to closely match it to real life reference.


Now let’s talk about Photo Mode.
Here you can see the UI we have when you press [P], to open the Photo Mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/63bfed2d07e17d95b58eda7d1651f088307d63d6.png[/img]

As a player you will also have the ability to zoom in and out to easier take pictures the way you want to. After taking a picture they will be stored inside our character photo album with a name assigned to them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/763cc36e16ba829708abd5fb1848b1df65d63929.png[/img]

And that is all for today, be sure to let us know in the comments what are your thoughts on the newest location in our game, would you like some changes made and also about the Photo Mode, if there is anything more you would like to see added.

P.S. There is also a sneak peak of our new car in the screenshots, maybe some of you would like to become "bandits", tell us what you think about it and we will have more info on it in the upcoming weeks. 

Remember to add our game to your wishlist and stay tuned for more updates to come in the next few weeks.

See you soon,
Grande Games

notes.title: Route 66 Devlog #4 - Trailer Park
notes.content:
Hello Dear Players,

We know it has been quite some time since our last Devlog, but rest assured our team has been hard at work, making more and more assets and locations for our game, as well as some interesting gameplay mechanics. Today we would like to showcase you another one of our locations and also assets that we have created for it.

Trailer Park

We knew we wanted to create a trailer park from the moment we started working on our game. We always considered it a great fit for our American journey, giving us the possibility of showcasing different places people live in, various interesting persons and so on. So like always we started by gathering as much reference as we can. After a few days of work we decided to follow these references. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/12d7d2602cb4c87d72c323b2f48955bffc5c9381.png[/img]

Next part was 3D modeling, we created our models with a lot of attention to details, but also considering the restraints of optimization. After all, we want our game to be playable by as many players as possible. We also wanted to have the possibility to easily change colors of our assets so that we could create multiple color variations very quickly. That is where the Unreal Engine power came in handy, we utilized its powerful shaders to create and easy to customize material, that with just a few sliders allows us to create multiple color versions of the same asset. So after a few weeks this is what we had created. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/67dfae86366a9a071a346c56d1266b859dddd0ea.png[/img]

But of course, we also wanted to have different variants of campers and trailers, so we also created them and started placing them in our game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/eb044ec5bf48b48ceca0bc7b656df1d9580b402c.png[/img]

Last but very important part was the interior. We wanted these places to feel old, abandoned, but also didn’t want too much clutter so that it is still easy for players to find important items, collectibles and such. Here you can see few examples of our interiors. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/eb59faec4be4e40c51ecd326717cb40a474f7155.png[/img]

And that is all for now, as always we would love to hear your feedback, so let us know in the comments what you think about the models that we have created. Is there anything you would like to see changed or added? And remember to add our game to your Wishlist so that you will get notified as soon as we post our next Devlog. 

Cheers,

Grande Games Team.

notes.title: ROUTE 66 DEVLOG #2
notes.content:
Hello Dear Fans,

Last month we presented you with the first location from our game “Diner”. The feedback you gave us was amazing and made us work twice as hard so that we can deliver you the best game possible. 

You saw the “Diner”, but what would be an american route without a place to stop along a journey like “Dive Bar”, to rest for a little, drink some beer and play some darts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/986f49673138201bb50d9312f149943901d4465c.png[/img]

In our “Dive Bar” players will be able to interact with numerous NPC-s, take missions from them, hear numerous stories that they have to share, play minigames of Darts and Pool. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/f8a7ac6ca7855cb74356ad5ea582a5fbe3863b39.png[/img]

And don’t forget about drinks and beers. Our “Dive Bar” has something for everyone. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/a98df2c42b4e0135700b3f95e2fc0e6f3913ad7c.png[/img]

Well, that would be all for today. We hope you enjoyed what we had to show for today, remember to add our game to Steam Wishlist, so that you won’t miss any Devlogs, as there will be plenty of them in the upcoming weeks, showing more and more of our game.

notes.title: ROUTE 66 DEVLOG #1 DINER
notes.content:
Hello Dear Fans,
We are super happy to present you with our first Devlog for Route 66 Simulator. Our team is hard at work and we will be soon presenting you a lot of stuff that we have been working on the past couple of months. Firstly, today we would like to show you our Diner, which is still a work in progress, but we are very happy with what we have so far and would like to hear your opinions and comments about it.
Like with everything we do, we started with gathering references for our American Diner, so that it would look as close to real thing as possible. Our goal is to make every player feel like driving through USA Route 66 every second of gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944501/cd9088ae858d6cf5bea1abb9294b478d3d0e8e21.png[/img]

After carefully examining different options for our Diner, our team has decided on creating something based on these reference images. We started our 3D work, carefully crafting each of the assets to make it
look as good as possible, while also caring for optimisation of each asset, so that our game can run as smoothly as possible. Here are the results of our work, as stated previously they are still work in progress and if you have any suggestions feel free to leave them in comments, so that our team can work on improving our assets based on your feedback.
